page.overview:
Who is Officer 227?

Officer 227, known as Duel Chaser 227 (デュエルチェイサー２２７, Dyueru Cheisā Ni Ni Nana) in the Japanese version and the English version of Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist, is a character appearing in that game and Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution.

He is a video game depiction of Officer 227, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime. Defeating him once in the campaign unlocks his character icon for Deck construction, and defeating him across all appearances unlocks his Challenge Deck.
